{{Top|leg}}
The '''Trade Commission''' was the governing body of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tallaan]]. Elected by popular vote, the council appointed one of its own to serve as [[first executive]], who was the world's leader.<ref name="LE">''[[Lords of the Expanse]]''</ref>
